interpretation.success: Robust calibration for new alert episode starts fixed the dominant pipeline-001 failure. Early-new-alert recall rose from 52.7% to 83.1%, and end-to-end early top-three actionable recall rose from 52.7% to 78.9%, while no-leak nuisance episodes remained low and slightly improved.
interpretation.localization: The frozen localizer remained strong: conditional on an early alert, the true node was in the top three 94.9% of the time and top-one for 53 of 59 early-detected events.
interpretation.remaining_limit: Net1 contains only nine candidate nodes. Before claiming utility-scale localization readiness, repeat the frozen alert policy on another fresh Net1 cohort and then move to a larger network/topology benchmark without using its holdout outcomes for tuning.
interpretation.next_iteration: Run a replication cohort with the pipeline-002 detector policy and localizer frozen exactly as-is. If performance is stable, graduate the benchmark to a larger water network where top-three localization represents a materially larger field-search reduction.
